jobs.title: GCB Tendering Team Leader (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity We are looking for a highly motivated and experienced  Team Lead for GCB tendering team  to join our dynamic team at Hitachi Energy Ltd. In this role, you will lead a group of GCB tendering managers, drive performance, manage daily sales operation and play a key part in achieving ambitious maintenance sales growth. If you are passionate about leadership, strategy, sales tool and process improvement, and building strong client relationships, this is your chance to make an impact. How you'll make an impact Lead, mentor, and coach GCB tendering team members to achieve and exceed team and individual sales targets Conduct one-on-one meetings to provide constructive feedback, identify training needs, and support professional development Recruit, onboard and develop of new team members Elaborate and implement effective sales strategies to increase GCB maintenance market penetration and drive sustainable service order growth Coordination and active pursuits of quotations\/tenders. Ensure professional quotations within the required timeline, provide technical\/commercial clarification, follow negotiations till booking the orders and handover to Order Management team in an efficient way. Ensure consistent development and implementation of sales tools such as Configure Price Quote (CPQ) platform with its process guideline and practices; Continuously improve the sales tools and process with the target of standardization, efficient end-to-end process and improved speed in quotation time in the GCB tendering team. Monitor the GCB maintenance sales pipeline, forecast results, and provide regular performance reports and market intelligence to management Support in developing innovative and customer-oriented GCB maintenance service solutions and proactively drive their market introduction Collaborate with LSU sales team, and internal functions to align sales efforts with company objectives Stay informed about GCB market trends, market conditions, and competitor activities to refine strategies and proactively share information with internal stakeholders. Your background Senior Professional with international business experience and a proven track-record in GCB business 5 years' experience in sales, technical sales or business development Proven track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets. Strong knowledge of sales methodologies, account management, CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce), and analytics Excellent leadership, cross-cultural communication, and presentation skills Ability to inspire, influence and develop a high-performing team Strategic thinker with strong problem-solving abilities Strong customer focus and result-oriented personality Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite English on negotiation level, other languages (e.g. German) are a plus More about us You will do interesting and enriching work as part of a dynamic, passionate, and collaborative team committed to innovation and continuous improvement You will be stretched, encouraged, and supported to grow – we pride ourselves on providing strong learning and development opportunities 
• We offer an environment that fosters collaboration, connection, and diversity of thought Our culture is one of a kind: come as you are and bring your unique attributes, passion, and drive to the design and management of Pensions & Benefits at Hitachi Energy, contributing to making us ‘the place to be' and to our purpose of advancing a sustainable energy future for all Flexible working, including hybrid\/remote working opportunities A competitive compensation and benefits package

jobs.title: R&D Test System Integration Engineer 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity   Join the Product Evaluation & Qualification team at Hitachi Energy Semiconductors in Lenzburg. You will play a key role in developing, integrating, and commissioning advanced electrical test systems used for the characterization, validation, and qualification of power semiconductor devices and modules. In this role, you will design, integrate, and commission electrical test solutions while collaborating with experts across R&D, laboratories, and external partners. To strengthen our laboratory and test infrastructure capabilities, we are looking for a highly motivated engineer who enjoys combining system thinking with hands-on engineering. This role offers broad exposure to power electronics, laboratory infrastructure, and product qualification activities. You will continuously expand your technical expertise while contributing to innovative technologies for renewable energy, transportation, industrial applications, and HVDC systems. How you'll make an impact   Develop and integrate electrical test systems for power semiconductor characterization and evaluation Lead the design of solutions for high-power testing applications Commission, troubleshoot, and optimize laboratory test equipment Collaborate with R&D teams to support product development and validation Integrate measurement systems, sensors, power supplies, and automation solutions Define system requirements and coordinate activities with external partners Investigate equipment failures and support root cause analysis activities Create technical documentation, specifications, and test procedures Your background   Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Electronics or a related field Experience in system engineering, hardware integration, or test engineering Solid understanding of power electronics and electrical measurement systems Hands-on experience with commissioning, troubleshooting, and laboratory equipment Ability to read and understand electrical schematics and technical drawings Strong communication skills and fluency in English More About Us We pride ourselves on offering a holistic range of competitive benefit programs to support your financial, physical, and mental well-being, as well as your personal development. We want you to truly thrive with us – in work and out.   Benefits: Generous retirement savings options to help you plan for your future Subsidized gym memberships to support your health and wellness Enjoy discounts on a variety of products and services, including electronics, groceries, and travel If you are a highly skilled and motivated engineer looking to join a dynamic team, we encourage you to apply!

jobs.title: Intern - Process Engineering 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity  We are looking for a motivated engineering intern to join the Bipolar Semiconductor Process Engineering team in Lenzburg. The internship offers a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of semiconductor manufacturing, quality engineering, and digital transformation.  The primary objective of this assignment is to transform an existing Digital Quality Control (DQC) prototype into a robust production application that can be used daily by operators and engineers on the Bipolar manufacturing line. The solution will become an integral part of the factory's quality management system and support the prevention of defects, process deviations, and customer escapes. The DQC initiative builds on ongoing efforts to digitalize quality checkpoints and process controls within the Bipolar semiconductor fabrication environment.  This is a hands-on assignment with direct exposure to semiconductor manufacturing processes, operator workflows, quality assurance systems, database applications, and continuous improvement activities.  How you'll make an impact  Analyze and enhance the existing Digital Quality Control (DQC) solution to support its transition into daily manufacturing operations  Develop user-friendly software features and workflows that improve quality control, usability, and operational efficiency  Collaborate with operators, engineers, shift leaders, and quality specialists to gather requirements and implement practical solutions  Support the integration of manufacturing process controls and quality checkpoints into digital systems  Analyze process and quality data, identify trends, and contribute to data-driven improvement initiatives  Create dashboards, reports, and visualizations to support operational and quality-related decision making  Participate in testing, validation, deployment, and user training activities to ensure a successful system rollout  Contribute to technical documentation, work instructions, and continuous improvement efforts that enhance long-term system reliability and performance  Your background  Degree, apprenticeship, relevant training, or practical experience in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, Electrical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Semiconductor Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related technical field  Experience with software development using Python, C#, JavaScript, or similar programming languages  Familiarity with databases, SQL, and data management concepts.   Understanding of data visualization, reporting tools, and analytical methods  Knowledge of software testing, debugging, and quality assurance practices  Interest in digital manufacturing, Industry 4.0, process automation, and continuous improvement  Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a hands-on and proactive mindset  Effective communication skills and the ability to collaborate with multidisciplinary teams in a manufacturing environment  More about us   Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

jobs.title: Global Manufacturing Process Definition & Improvement Specialist Professional
jobs.description: The Opportunity At Hitachi Energy, our purpose is advancing a sustainable energy future for all. We bring power to our homes, schools, hospitals, and factories. Join us and work with fantastic people, while learning and developing yourself on projects that have a real impact to our communities and society. Bring your passion, bring your energy, and be part of a global team that appreciates a simple truth: Diversity + Collaboration = Great Innovation. As a Global Casting Process Definition & Improvement Specialist Professional at HITACHI ENERGY LTD, you will be responsible for defining, optimizing, and improving Casting processes and equipment across our global operations. This role focuses on driving efficiency, standardizing best practices, and implementing innovative solutions to enhance productivity and product quality. How you'll make an impact: Lead the development and documentation of standardized casting processes and equipment, work instructions, and best practices across various production sites globally. Analyze existing casting processes to identify bottlenecks, inefficiencies, and areas for improvement using lean manufacturing and Six Sigma methodologies. Design and implement process and equipment improvements, including new technologies, automation solutions, and operational workflows, to optimize production output, reduce costs, and enhance quality. Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including R&D, engineering, quality, and production, to ensure seamless integration of new processes, equipment and technologies.Develop and deliver training programs for manufacturing personnel on new and improved processes and tools. Monitor and analyze key performance indicators (KPIs) related to casting processes, identifying trends and recommending corrective actions.Conduct process audits and assessments to ensure compliance with defined standards and identify opportunities for continuous improvement. Support the implementation of digital manufacturing initiatives and Industry 4.0 technologies.Stay abreast of industry best practices, new technologies, and regulatory requirements related to casting processes. Manage complex projects related to process and equipment improvement, ensuring timely completion and adherence to budget. Responsible to ensure compliance with applicable external & internal regulations, procedures & guidelines. Your Background Bachelor's degree in Engineering (Chemical, Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial, or Manufacturing preferred) or a related technical field. Master's degree is a plus. Strong years of experience in casting process engineering, process improvement, or a similar role within a global manufacturing environment. Proven track record of successfully implementing process improvements and driving operational excellence&Strong knowledge of lean manufacturing principles, Six Sigma methodologies (Green Belt or Black Belt certification preferred), and other continuous improvement tools. Experience with manufacturing execution systems (MES), enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems, and other relevant manufacturing software.Proficiency in process mapping, value stream mapping, and other process analysis techniques. Excellent project management, analytical, problem-solving, decision-making, communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to lead complex initiatives and effectively influence stakeholders at all organizational levels. Ability to travel internationally as required to various manufacturing sites. Fluency in English is required; proficiency in other languages is a plus. More about us We pride ourselves on offering a holistic range of competitive benefits to support your financial, physical, and mental wellbeing, as well as your professional growth. We want you to truly thrive with us, in work and out.

jobs.title: Territory Sales & Marketing Manager 80-100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity Hitachi Energy Insulation and Components portfolio covers a wide range of transformer applications, from the small distribution transformers till the bigger power transformers. Our customers portfolio includes Transformer OEMs, components distributors, utilities as well as services companies. In order to support our operations in Europe, we are looking for an experienced Territory Sales and Marketing Manager who will manage a part of the DACH region, mainly the German market . The role can be based either in Germany or Switzerland . How you will make an impact Will be responsible for Sales and Marketing of full I&C portfolio within allocated countries for 3rd party transformer OEMs. Also accountable for delivering OR budget for all applicable I&C factories, for direct customers and also end-customers Conduct technical trainings for all types of customers Liaise with our I&C factories globally in order that quotations and proper technical support are provided. Manage product customization projects. Liaise with Utilities in order to homologate and have approved I&C portfolio, clarify tender specifications Feed Market Intelligence to I&C factories, to our Global Product Group and to our local product managers Provide a regular forecast on OR per country for the full I&C portfolio Collaborate with Hitachi Energy Sales channels and also 3rd parties on Service projects Create synergies between I&C factories in order to increase sales volumes per project Support all promotional Marketing events in Europe organised by I&C Product line Marketing Your background Degree (Bachelor or Master) in a technical discipline, ideally Electrical or Mechanical engineering plus further qualification in business administration More than 10 years of experience in technical and international sales and marketing, supporting multiple products, customers and countries Market or product knowledge in the field of power transformers or distribution transformers insulation and components is essential Experience in business development, account management and cross-selling across systems, solutions, products and service categories Understanding of contract negotiation, risk management and commercial and legal terms Exceptional communication and negotiation skills, customer-focused. Ability to establish and manage long-term customer relationships. Excellent planning and organization skills Sound knowledge of MS Office and CRM, preferably Salesforce Business fluent in German and English, spoken and written, is a must. Any other European language skill is an advantage Be willing to travel for international business trips (up to 40%) More about us You will do interesting and enriching work as part of a dynamic, passionate, and collaborative team committed to innovation and continuous improvement You will be stretched, encouraged, and supported to grow – we pride ourselves on providing strong learning and development opportunities 
• We offer an environment that fosters collaboration, connection, and diversity of thought Our culture is one of a kind: come as you are and bring your unique attributes, passion, and drive to the design and management of Pensions & Benefits at Hitachi Energy, contributing to making us ‘the place to be' and to our purpose of advancing a sustainable energy future for all Flexible working, including hybrid\/remote working opportunities A competitive compensation and benefits package

jobs.title: Installed Base Manager GPG Service (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
About the Position As Installed Base Manager GPG Service , you will own the business logic and governance behind our global installed base ecosystem across High Voltage and Transformer products. Your focus is to ensure asset and service data are accurate, connected, and scalable throughout the entire lifecycle, enabling service growth, operational excellence, and data-driven decision making. Acting as the bridge between Service, Product Management, Sales, Digital, Data, and IT, you will translate installed base intelligence into tangible business value. How You'll Make an Impact Own and continuously improve the service lifecycle framework, linking products, assets, maintenance strategies, service opportunities, field service execution, and customer value creation Drive the quality, consistency, and governance of installed base data to support analytics, maintenance planning, and service growth initiatives Establish and promote global standards, ensuring harmonized business processes across product portfolios and regions Shape the strategic development of OneIB, leveraging AI, automation, and advanced analytics to improve opportunity identification, service planning, and decision support Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to enhance platform capabilities and maximize business impact Your Background Degree in Engineering, Business Informatics, Industrial Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience Experience in asset lifecycle management, service operations, or service business models within industrial or infrastructure environments Strong analytical mindset with expertise in data governance, business process design, and lifecycle modeling Familiarity with installed base management, CRM, ERP, and field service management environments (e.g., SAP, Salesforce, OneIB, DPS, or similar platforms) Fluent in English and comfortable working in a global, cross-functional environment Passion for digital transformation, AI-driven solutions, and service business growth More About Us Join a global organization dedicated to advancing service excellence and supporting critical infrastructure worldwide. You will play a key role in driving digital transformation, enabling sustainable service growth, and helping shape the future of data-driven and intelligent service solutions. 
• We offer an international environment, meaningful career opportunities, and the chance to make a lasting impact on customers, teams, and the industry.

jobs.title: Continuous Improvement Manager 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity Are you passionate about driving operational excellence and creating measurable impact on the shop floor? As Continuous Improvement Manager, you will partner with factory and operations leaders to identify improvement opportunities, remove bottlenecks, and implement Lean Six Sigma initiatives across the value chain. This is a highly visible role where you will coach teams, lead transformational projects, and help shape a culture of continuous improvement across our manufacturing operations. How you'll make an impact Act as a trusted Continuous Improvement advisor and sparring partner for Factory Managers, Operations Managers, and leadership teams, driving data-driven analyses, optimization initiatives, and operational excellence programs Work across the entire value chain to identify bottlenecks, remove constraints, improve flow, and maximize overall business performance Maintain a strong shop-floor presence through regular Gemba activities, working side-by-side with operators, supervisors, and managers to identify opportunities, solve problems, and sustain improvements where value is created Drive and promote Kaizen Events and Rapid Improvement Workshops to accelerate problem-solving, eliminate waste, and deliver fast, sustainable results Train, coach, and mentor employees and leaders in Lean Six Sigma methodologies, supporting certification programs and building continuous improvement capabilities throughout the organization Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to map, analyze, redesign, and optimize end-to-end business processes Lead the deployment of Lean principles, standardization, best practices, and benchmarking activities across manufacturing sites Monitor, track, and communicate improvement program results through KPIs, ensuring sustainable implementation and measurable business impact Travel regularly to support factories, conduct workshops, coach teams, and drive improvement initiatives across the organization (minimum 20% travel required) Your background Bachelor's or master's degree in engineering, Operations Management, or a related technical field Minimum 5 years of experience in Continuous Improvement, Operational Excellence, or Process Engineering, with proven hands-on experience in a manufacturing environment. Factory experience is mandatory Strong understanding and practical application of Lean Six Sigma methodologies (Green Belt required, Black Belt preferred) Proven experience leading Kaizen Events, Gemba activities, process mapping, value stream analysis, root cause analysis, and change management initiatives Demonstrated ability to identify bottlenecks, remove constraints, and improve end-to-end value stream performance Strong communication, facilitation, training, and presentation skills, with experience delivering workshops and Lean Six Sigma certification programs Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and data-driven decision-making skills Self-driven, hands-on, and comfortable working on the shop floor alongside production teams to deliver sustainable improvements Willingness to travel regularly to support factories and improvement initiatives across the region (minimum 20% travel required) Fluent in English; German or Swedish is considered an advantage More about us   Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

jobs.title: Equipment Engineer -Diffusion, 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity    Join Hitachi, Ltd. as an Equipment Engineer and play a key role in optimizing and maintaining manufacturing equipment to ensure high performance, reliability, and efficiency. You will work in a collaborative environment, contributing to continuous improvement and supporting innovative manufacturing processes.  As a Diffusion Maintenance Engineer, you will play a critical role in ensuring the availability, efficiency, and continuous improvement of semiconductor high temperature production systems. This role focuses on the Corrective and Preventive maintenance and optimization of Diffusion & Cleaning equipment while working closely with cross-functional teams to enhance safety, productivity, and system reliability. How you'll make an impact  Develop and implement modifications and upgrades to existing manufacturing equipment to improve efficiency, yield, and safety  Perform routine maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair of complex manufacturing machinery and systems  Analyse equipment performance data to identify trends, predict failures, and implement preventive measures  Collaborate with production, R&D, and quality teams to resolve equipment-related issues and optimize processes  Create and maintain documentation for equipment operation, maintenance procedures, and technical specifications  Train technicians and operators on new equipment and updated procedures  Manage spare parts inventory and ensure timely procurement of required components and ensure compliance with safety standards and environmental regulations  Support the selection, installation, and qualification of new manufacturing equipment  Your background  Bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering or electrical Engineering  Minimum 2 years of experience in equipment engineering within a manufacturing environment  Experience in the Semiconductor field is a must Strong understanding of mechanical, electrical, and control systems  Solid understanding of electronics, mechanics, and pneumatics; experience with Diffusion Semiconductor systems (e.g., ASM, Centrotherm furnaces) Proven ability to troubleshoot complex machinery and identify root causes of failures  Familiarity with lean manufacturing principles and continuous improvement methods  Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills  Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced environment  English is mandatory, German is beneficial   More about us   Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

C'est une excellente occasion pour un ingénieur en début de carrière qui veut s'exposer à la gestion des produits, à la gestion du cycle de vie des produits et à la conformité commerciale dans un environnement industriel mondial. En étroite collaboration avec les équipes de l'ingénierie, des ventes, de la fabrication, de la qualité et de la chaîne d'approvisionnement, vous vous assurerez que les produits répondent aux attentes des clients, aux exigences du marché et aux normes réglementaires tout en contribuant à des initiatives d'amélioration et d'innovation continues. Contribuez à la mise au point de produits, à des projets d'innovation et à des activités de feuille de route. Mener des recherches sur le marché et les concurrents afin de cerner les possibilités et les tendances. Maintenir la documentation technique sur les produits, les données sur les produits et les matériaux de commercialisation. Collaborer avec des équipes interfonctionnelles pour appuyer les lancements, les changements et les demandes des clients. Soutenir les activités de gestion de la durabilité, de la conformité et de l'obsolescence des produits. Diriger les activités de conformité commerciale, y compris les classifications de produits, la maintenance des données douanières et les exigences de contrôle des exportations. Des compétences linguistiques supplémentaires sont un avantage Plus sur nous Nos pratiques de travail flexibles vous aident à optimiser la performance personnelle et commerciale tout en créant un environnement où tous les employés peuvent développer leurs compétences et grandir.

jobs.title: Global Internal HSE Assessment Program Lead - BU Transformers (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity BU Transformers is looking for a motivated HSE Assessment Program Lead. In this role, you will be leading the HSE Assessment Program that will help on BU compliance with BUTR HSE Instructions and BU operational audits performed by Quality, Engineering, R&D and bring the right guidance, with trained and competent HSE professionals. Finally, you will monitor the BUTR performance regarding the 3LoD Model, follow up, monitor effective corrective actions implementation and close out. You will provide expert guidance on internal HSE Assessment as well. This position requires solid background on setting up and rolling out internal HSE Assessment Programs, based on ISO Norms, excellent communication skills, a proactive approach to problem-solving, and the ability to influence stakeholders at all levels. The Program Lead will play a pivotal role in completing the cycle of BUTR strategic HSE development. As we advance our HSE Programs rollout to strengthen Culture and Performance, this position will support the BUTR HSE Function to develop the capability to monitor and verify the HSE Programs effective implementation across our HUBs, Units and BU Functions. This role will also reinforce actions aligned with the Three Lines of Defense model and enhance our ability to close gaps identified during Global HSE internal audits. By doing so, the HSE Assessment Program Lead will support the rollout of the BU HSE Strategy, supporting cultural transformation and performance improvement as we expand capacity and meet rising operational expectations and targets. As a global role it is required to travel internationally up to 30% of the time. How you'll make an impact Create the BUTR Internal HSE Assessment Program, roll it out across the BU and create the network to support the assessment process complete, supporting and guiding until improvements are effectively implemented. Ensure compliance assessments and inspections are conducted across operational areas and contractor activities, with accurate reporting of findings and timely corrective actions. Contribute to assess and improve BUTR HSE Management Systems. Support other Programs in a transversal way, integrating the Internal HSE Assessment Program output on improvements and learnings for other BU HSE Programs. Ensure a practical and pragmatic approach on problem solving, remaining very close to BUTR Units, creating easy and effective understanding on demands after assessments and support attitude. Your background University degree (Bachelor or Master) in Occupational Health and Safety, HSE or related field 8+ years' experience in HSE roles Proven experience in auditing, risk assessment, management systems, process improvement, MOC and incident investigation.  Ability to influence stakeholders and drive cultural change.​​​​ Fluent in English. Other languages would be an advantage for candidates. Trained and experienced on ISO 19011, 45001, 14001. Experience on ISO 50001 and 9001, will be convenient. Competent on international HSE legislation.

Ability to influence stakeholders and drive cultural change.​​​​ Fluent in English. Other languages would be an advantage for candidates. Trained and experienced on ISO 19011, 45001, 14001. Experience on ISO 50001 and 9001, will be convenient. Competent on international HSE legislation.
descriptionByLocale.en: The opportunity BU Transformers is looking for a motivated HSE Assessment Program Lead. In this role, you will be leading the HSE Assessment Program that will help on BU compliance with BUTR HSE Instructions and BU operational audits performed by Quality, Engineering, R&D and bring the right guidance, with trained and competent HSE professionals. jobs.title: Operating Unit Engineering Manager for Substation Automation Systems, HUB Europe
jobs.description: The Opportunity We are looking for an Engineering Manager within the Operating Unit, Substation Automation Systems Europe . In this role, you will provide the professional engineering resources required for the design, engineering, testing, and commissioning of systems delivered through commercial projects under the responsibility of the Operating Unit. You will drive operational and execution excellence through effective engineering management while fostering collaboration across the engineering community within the Operating Unit's countries to share solutions, balance workloads, and leverage lessons learned. Key responsibilities include: Allocating the right engineering resources to project teams in accordance with S&OP processes. Establishing efficient interfaces between engineering teams and OPCs while increasing OPC utilization. Managing customer relationships with respect to technical requirements. In this role, you will report to the Operating Unit Manager, Substation Automation Systems Europe . How You'll Make an Impact Lead the engineering teams and own the performance management of engineering deliverables across the Operating Unit in Europe. Serve as the Business Process Owner for engineering and testing processes. Mentor and develop engineering function leaders and team members, fostering a culture of innovation, collaboration, and excellence. Build and maintain strong relationships with key customers, as well as internal and external stakeholders. Coordinate the implementation of and adherence to global engineering processes, standards, practices, procedures, tools, and digitalization initiatives in collaboration with the Global Product Group and other Operating Units across the Business Unit. Define and lead the implementation of continuous improvement initiatives across engineering processes and tools, aligned with Business Unit and Global Product Group strategies. Monitor KPIs and performance metrics to ensure operational excellence and strategic alignment. Participate in the budgeting process together with the Operating Unit Manager and Controller. Ensure that the area of responsibility is structured to support the business model, adequately staffed with skilled resources, and effectively managed. Guide, motivate, and develop direct and indirect reports in accordance with HR policies. Oversee competency assessments and ensure engineering personnel hold the appropriate licenses and certifications. Champion Hitachi Energy's core values of safety, integrity, and quality by taking responsibility for your actions while caring for your colleagues and the business. Your Background Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Energy Engineering, or a related field. More than 15 years of engineering experience in the energy sector, including at least 5 years in a global leadership role. A results-oriented leader with a strong passion for people development, leadership, stakeholder engagement, and collaboration. An excellent communicator with the ability to influence beyond your direct organizational responsibilities and think strategically. Experience working within a multinational corporation and a global engineering environment. Strong knowledge of energy systems, grid infrastructure, renewable technologies, and regulatory frameworks within the utility and\/or industrial infrastructure project business, combined with a solid understanding of engineering principles and a proven track record of delivering complex engineering projects across multiple geographies.

descriptionByLocale.it: L'opportunità Siamo alla ricerca di un responsabile dell'ingegneria all'interno dell'unità operativa, Substation Automation Systems Europe . In questo ruolo, fornirete le risorse ingegneristiche professionali necessarie per la progettazione, l'ingegneria, il test e la messa in servizio di sistemi consegnati attraverso progetti commerciali sotto la responsabilità dell'Unità Operativa. Potrai guidare l'eccellenza operativa e l'esecuzione attraverso un'efficace gestione dell'ingegneria, promuovendo la collaborazione tra la comunità ingegneristica all'interno dei paesi dell'Unità Operativa per condividere soluzioni, carichi di lavoro di equilibrio e le lezioni di leva imparate. Le responsabilità chiave includono: Alllocation delle risorse ingegneristiche giuste per progettare i team in conformità con i processi S&OP. Stabilire interfacce efficienti tra team di ingegneria e OPC, aumentando l'utilizzo di OPC. Gestione dei rapporti con i clienti rispetto alle esigenze tecniche. In questo ruolo, si segnala al Manager Unità Operativa, Substation Automation Systems Europe . Come farete un impatto guidare i team di ingegneria e possedere la gestione delle prestazioni dei materiali di ingegneria in tutta l'unità operativa in Europa. Servire come proprietario del processo aziendale per i processi di ingegneria e test. Mentore e sviluppo di leader di funzioni ingegneristiche e membri del team, promuovendo una cultura di innovazione, collaborazione e eccellenza. Costruire e mantenere forti relazioni con i clienti chiave, così come gli stakeholder interni ed esterni. Coordinare l'implementazione e l'adesione a processi di ingegneria globale, standard, pratiche, procedure, strumenti e iniziative di digitalizzazione in collaborazione con il Global Product Group e altre unità operative in tutta l'unità aziendale. Definire e condurre l'implementazione di iniziative di miglioramento continuo attraverso processi e strumenti di ingegneria, allineati con le strategie Business Unit e Global Product Group. Monitorare i KPI e le metriche di performance per garantire l'eccellenza operativa e l'allineamento strategico. Partecipa al processo di budgeting insieme al Responsabile Unità Operativa e al Controller. Assicurarsi che l'area di responsabilità sia strutturata per sostenere il modello aziendale, adeguatamente occupata con risorse qualificate e gestita efficacemente. Guidare, motivare e sviluppare rapporti diretti e indiretti secondo le politiche HR. Controllare le valutazioni delle competenze e garantire che il personale di ingegneria detiene le licenze e le certificazioni appropriate. I valori fondamentali di sicurezza, integrità e qualità del campione Hitachi Energy assumendo la responsabilità delle vostre azioni mentre si occupano dei vostri colleghi e degli affari. La tua laurea di primo livello o master in ingegneria elettrica, ingegneria energetica, o un campo correlato. Più di 15 anni di esperienza ingegneristica nel settore energetico, tra cui almeno 5 anni in un ruolo di leadership globale. Leader orientato ai risultati con una forte passione per lo sviluppo, la leadership, l'impegno degli stakeholder e la collaborazione. Un eccellente comunicatore con la capacità di influenzare al di là delle vostre responsabilità organizzative dirette e pensare strategicamente. Esperienza di lavoro all'interno di una multinazionale e di un ambiente di ingegneria globale. Forte conoscenza dei sistemi energetici, delle infrastrutture di rete, delle tecnologie rinnovabili e dei quadri normativi all'interno del business del progetto di utilità e\/o infrastruttura industriale, combinati con una solida comprensione dei principi ingegneristici e con un comprovato record di tracciato di fornitura di progetti di ingegneria complessi in più geografie.

descriptionByLocale.de: Die Chance Wir suchen einen Engineering Manager innerhalb der Operating Unit, Substation Automation Systems Europe. In dieser Rolle stellen Sie die professionellen Engineering-Ressourcen bereit, die für das Design, Engineering, Testen und Inbetriebnehmen von Systemen erforderlich sind, die durch kommerzielle Projekte unter der Verantwortung der Operating Unit geliefert werden. Sie werden operative und exekutive Exzellenz durch effektives Engineering-Management fördern und gleichzeitig die Zusammenarbeit in der gesamten Engineering-Community in den Ländern der Operating Unit fördern, um Lösungen auszutauschen, Workloads auszugleichen und die gewonnenen Erkenntnisse zu nutzen. Zu den wichtigsten Aufgaben gehören: Zuweisung der richtigen Engineering-Ressourcen an Projektteams gemäß S&OP-Prozessen. Etablierung effizienter Schnittstellen zwischen Engineering-Teams und OPCs bei gleichzeitiger Erhöhung der OPC-Auslastung. Management der Kundenbeziehungen in Bezug auf technische Anforderungen. In dieser Funktion berichten Sie an den Operating Unit Manager, Substation Automation Systems Europe. How You'll Make an Impact Führen Sie die Engineering-Teams und besitzen Sie das Leistungsmanagement von Engineering-Leistungen in der gesamten operativen Einheit in Europa. Dienen Sie als Business Process Owner für Engineering- und Testprozesse. Mentor und entwickeln Engineering Funktion Führungskräfte und Teammitglieder, eine Kultur der Innovation, Zusammenarbeit und Exzellenz zu fördern. Aufbau und Pflege starker Beziehungen zu wichtigen Kunden sowie zu internen und externen Stakeholdern. Koordinieren Sie die Implementierung und Einhaltung globaler Engineering-Prozesse, Standards, Praktiken, Verfahren, Tools und Digitalisierungsinitiativen in Zusammenarbeit mit der Global Product Group und anderen operativen Einheiten in der gesamten Business Unit. Definieren und leiten Sie die Umsetzung von kontinuierlichen Verbesserungsinitiativen in allen Engineering-Prozessen und -Tools, ausgerichtet auf Business Unit- und Global Product Group-Strategien. Überwachung von KPIs und Leistungskennzahlen, um operative Exzellenz und strategische Ausrichtung zu gewährleisten. Beteiligen Sie sich am Budgetierungsprozess zusammen mit dem Operating Unit Manager und Controller. Stellen Sie sicher, dass der Verantwortungsbereich so strukturiert ist, dass er das Geschäftsmodell unterstützt, angemessen mit qualifizierten Ressourcen ausgestattet ist und effektiv verwaltet wird. Führen, motivieren und entwickeln Sie direkte und indirekte Berichte in Übereinstimmung mit HR-Richtlinien. Beaufsichtigen Sie die Kompetenzbewertungen und stellen Sie sicher, dass das Ingenieurpersonal über die entsprechenden Lizenzen und Zertifizierungen verfügt. Champion Hitachi Energys Kernwerte Sicherheit, Integrität und Qualität, indem Sie Verantwortung für Ihr Handeln übernehmen und sich um Ihre Kollegen und das Unternehmen kümmern. Ihr Hintergrund Bachelor- oder Master-Abschluss in Elektrotechnik, Energietechnik oder einem verwandten Bereich. Mehr als 15 Jahre Ingenieurserfahrung im Energiesektor, davon mindestens 5 Jahre in einer globalen Führungsrolle. Eine ergebnisorientierte Führungskraft mit einer starken Leidenschaft für die Entwicklung von Menschen, Führung, Stakeholder-Engagement und Zusammenarbeit. Ein ausgezeichneter Kommunikator mit der Fähigkeit, über Ihre direkten organisatorischen Verantwortlichkeiten hinaus Einfluss zu nehmen und strategisch zu denken. Erfahrung in einem multinationalen Unternehmen und einer globalen Engineering-Umgebung. Starkes Wissen über Energiesysteme, Netzinfrastruktur, erneuerbare Technologien und regulatorische Rahmenbedingungen innerhalb des Versorgungs- und / oder Industrieinfrastrukturprojektgeschäfts, kombiniert mit einem soliden Verständnis der technischen Prinzipien und einer nachgewiesenen Erfolgsbilanz bei der Bereitstellung komplexer Engineering-Projekte in mehreren Regionen.
descriptionByLocale.fr: L'opportunité Nous sommes à la recherche d'un responsable technique au sein de l'unité d'exploitation, Substation Automation Systems Europe . Dans ce rôle, vous fournirez les ressources d'ingénierie professionnelle nécessaires pour la conception, l'ingénierie, les essais et la mise en service de systèmes fournis dans le cadre de projets commerciaux sous la responsabilité de l'unité d'exploitation. Vous favoriserez l'excellence opérationnelle et l'exécution grâce à une gestion de l'ingénierie efficace tout en favorisant la collaboration dans les pays de l'unité opérationnelle afin de partager les solutions, d'équilibrer la charge de travail et de tirer parti des leçons apprises. Les principales responsabilités comprennent : Attribuer les ressources d'ingénierie appropriées aux équipes de projet conformément aux processus S&OP. Établir des interfaces efficaces entre les équipes de génie et les CPVP tout en augmentant l'utilisation du CPVP. Gestion des relations avec les clients en ce qui concerne les exigences techniques. Dans ce rôle, vous ferez rapport au gestionnaire d'unité d'exploitation, Sous-station Automation Systems Europe . Comment vous ferez un impact Dirigez les équipes d'ingénierie et possédez la gestion de la performance des produits d'ingénierie dans l'ensemble de l'unité opérationnelle en Europe. Servir de propriétaire de processus opérationnels pour les processus d'ingénierie et d'essai. Mentor et développer des chefs de fonction en génie et des membres d'équipe, favorisant une culture d'innovation, de collaboration et d'excellence. Établir et maintenir des relations solides avec les principaux clients, ainsi qu'avec les intervenants internes et externes. Coordonner la mise en œuvre et le respect des initiatives mondiales d'ingénierie, de normalisation, de pratiques, de procédures, d'outils et de numérisation, en collaboration avec le Groupe mondial des produits et d'autres unités opérationnelles de l'unité opérationnelle. Définir et diriger la mise en œuvre d'initiatives d'amélioration continue à l'échelle des processus et des outils d'ingénierie, conformément aux stratégies de l'unité opérationnelle et du Groupe mondial des produits. Surveiller les ICR et les mesures du rendement pour assurer l'excellence opérationnelle et l'alignement stratégique. Participer au processus de budgétisation en collaboration avec le gestionnaire et contrôleur de l'unité opérationnelle. Veiller à ce que le domaine de responsabilité soit structuré de façon à appuyer le modèle d'entreprise, à ce que le personnel dispose de ressources qualifiées et à ce qu'il soit géré efficacement. Guider, motiver et élaborer des rapports directs et indirects conformément aux politiques des RH. Superviser les évaluations des compétences et s'assurer que le personnel d'ingénierie détient les licences et les certifications appropriées. Les valeurs fondamentales de sécurité, d'intégrité et de qualité du champion Hitachi Energy en prenant la responsabilité de vos actions tout en prenant soin de vos collègues et de l'entreprise. Votre baccalauréat ou maîtrise en génie électrique, en génie énergétique ou dans un domaine connexe. Plus de 15 ans d'expérience en ingénierie dans le secteur de l'énergie, y compris au moins 5 ans dans un rôle de leadership mondial. Leader axé sur les résultats, passionné par le développement des personnes, le leadership, l'engagement des intervenants et la collaboration. Un excellent communicateur avec la capacité d'influencer au-delà de vos responsabilités organisationnelles directes et de penser stratégiquement. Expérience de travail au sein d'une société multinationale et d'un environnement d'ingénierie mondial. Forte connaissance des systèmes énergétiques, de l'infrastructure du réseau, des technologies renouvelables et des cadres réglementaires dans le cadre des activités de projets d'infrastructure d'utilité et/ou industrielle, combinée à une solide compréhension des principes d'ingénierie et à une expérience éprouvée de la réalisation de projets d'ingénierie complexes dans plusieurs géographies.

jobs.title: Field Service Engineer (w/m/d)
jobs.description:
Die Möglichkeit Hitachi Energy High Voltage Products ist der weltweit anerkannte Spezialist für Energieübertragung und Energieverteilung. Die Serviceeinheit ist für den weltweiten After Sales Support von Generatorenschutzschaltersystemen (GCB) und gasisolierten Schaltanlagen (GIS) inklusive Schulungen, Installation und Inbetriebnahme, planmäßiger Wartung, Zusatzleistungen, Troubleshooting, Erweiterungen, Umbauten und Austausch zuständig. Service ist der Schlüssel zum Erfolg. Als Kollege\/-in in unserem weltweit tätigen Service Team schätzen Sie die selbstständige, abwechslungsreiche und lösungsorientierte Arbeit. Nach einer vielseitigen, praxisorientierten Ausbildung in der Schweiz und im Ausland, werden Sie rund um den Globus GIS Installationen und Wartungen leiten. Es erwartet Sie eine technisch herausfordernde Stelle in einem multikulturellen Umfeld. Das können Sie bewirken Leitung von multikulturellen Baustellen weltweit für gasisolierte Schaltanlagen für das Spannungslevel von 110KV – 550KV Verantwortlich für die erfolgreiche Durchführung der vor Ort Installation, Wartungen und Reparaturen unter Einhaltung vertraglicher Termine und unter Berücksichtigung lokaler gesetzlicher Vorgaben Verantwortlich für die Qualität der vor Ort ausgeführten Arbeiten mittels Qualitätskontrolle und Beurteilung der Fähigkeiten von lokalen Hilfskräften Durchführen von Produkttraining vor Ort am Produkt und während der Installation Verantwortlich für die Evaluierung von Risiken und deren Minimierung. Koordination und Anweisung von Arbeitskräften Kostenkontrolle der eingesetzten Ressourcen und regelmäßiges Rapportieren an die Projektleitung Aktives Mitarbeiten an Prozessverbesserungen und proaktives Ergreifen von Maßnahmen zur Effizienzsteigerung der Tätigkeiten vor Ort Ihr Hintergrund Abgeschlossene Lehre in der Metallbau-, Elektro- oder Automobilbranche Elektrotechnische Grundkenntnisse sind ein Muss, elektrotechnische Weiterbildung von Vorteil Mindestens 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Montage- und Inbetriebsetzungsbereich Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse, mindestens B2 Bereitschaft zu nationalen und vor allem internationalen weltweiten Einsätzen mit bis zu 80 % Reisetätigkeit Flexibler, belastbarer und kommunikativer Teamplayer Flair für pragmatische und unkonventionelle Lösungssuche mit hohen Qualitäts- und Sicherheitsstandards Mehr über uns Spannende und abwechslungsreiche 
• Aufgaben mit viel Gestaltungsspielraum Attraktive Möglichkeiten zur Weiterbildung und persönlichen Entwicklung Interessante und vielfältige Tätigkeiten\/Projekte – auch mit Auslandseinsätzen Eingespieltes und dynamisches Team Offene Unternehmenskultur Attraktives Leistungspaket inklusive fixer Vergütung, Reise- und Verpflegungskosten sowie Mitspracherecht bei der Wahl der Unterkunft

jobs.title: Polymechaniker/in 80 - 100% (w/m/d)
jobs.description:
Über die Position Als Polymechaniker\/in bist du Teil einer Prototypenwerkstatt und des Systems Engineering im Hochleistungslabor Baden. In einem interdisziplinären Umfeld arbeitest du an unterschiedlichen 
• Aufgaben und bringst deine technischen Fähigkeiten in einem dynamischen und abwechslungsreichen Arbeitsumfeld ein. Dabei übernimmst du die Fertigung von Bauteilen für Versuchsgeräte und Anlagenkomponenten und unterstützt bei der Instandhaltung der Betriebseinrichtungen. Das kannst du bewirken Herstellung von Bauteilen für Versuchsgeräte und Anlagenkomponenten anhand von Skizzen und Fertigungszeichnungen Erstellung von CAD-Zeichnungen und 3D-Modellen Bedienung und Programmierung von konventionellen sowie CNC-gesteuerten Dreh- und Fräsmaschinen Durchführung mechanischer Bearbeitungen wie Drehen, Fräsen, Bohren sowie Nacharbeiten an Bauteilen Ausführung von Säge-, Scher- und Biegearbeiten Durchführung von Schweiss- und Lötarbeiten sowie Bereitschaft, diese Fähigkeiten weiter auszubauen Mitarbeit in der Prototypenwerkstatt und enge Zusammenarbeit mit Entwicklung, Systems Engineering und Unterhalt Sicherstellung der Instandhaltung von Betriebseinrichtungen inklusive Dokumentation Das bringst du mit Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Polymechaniker\/in oder eine vergleichbare technische Ausbildung Erfahrung in der Fertigung von Bauteilen nach Skizzen und technischen Zeichnungen Fundierte Kenntnisse in der Bedienung und Programmierung von konventionellen sowie CNC-gesteuerten Maschinen Erfahrung in der Erstellung von CAD-Zeichnungen und Modellen; CAM-Kenntnisse sind von Vorteil Handwerkliches Geschick sowie Erfahrung in mechanischen Bearbeitungsverfahren; Kenntnisse im Schweissen und Löten sind ein Plus Teamfähigkeit, Eigeninitiative und Flexibilität sowie Freude an der Arbeit in einem interdisziplinären und dynamischen Umfeld Mehr über uns Hitachi Energy gestaltet die Energiezukunft mit innovativen Technologien für eine nachhaltige und zuverlässige Energieversorgung. Bei uns erwartet dich ein modernes Arbeitsumfeld, ein starkes Team und die Möglichkeit, aktiv an zukunftsorientierten Lösungen mitzuwirken.

jobs.title: Secondary Design Engineer 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity We are looking for a Secondary Design Engineer to join our GIS engineering team. In this role, you will support the execution of secondary engineering deliverables for high-voltage GIS projects, including Local Control Cabinet (LCC) and digital substation applications. You will contribute to engineering documentation across project phases and help deliver high-quality, standard-compliant results while building your expertise in secondary design engineering and tools such as Zuken E3. How you'll make an impact Prepare schematics and related engineering documents for GIS secondary engineering scopes, including LCC and digital substation applications Support engineering execution across project phases, from base design and detail design through manufacturing documentation and as-built updates Create preliminary BOMs, reports, and manufacturing documents using approved engineering tools and standard processes Perform structured self-checks and contribute to technically correct, high-quality, and standard-compliant deliverables Support technical clarifications with internal stakeholders, project teams, and factories, and help document and close open points Contribute to continuous improvement, standardization, and engineering best practices, including participation in relevant expert communities Apply internal guidelines, engineering standards, and quality requirements while supporting safe and efficient project execution Your background Degree in Electrical Engineering or a related engineering discipline 2–3 years of professional experience in secondary engineering, design engineering, or project engineering is expected Practical experience with engineering tools such as Zuken E3 or comparable ECAD \/ engineering tools is required Basic knowledge of GIS, secondary engineering principles, and applicable standards such as IEC, IEEE, or ANSI is beneficial Structured and reliable way of working, willingness to learn, and ability to collaborate across functions and disciplines Fluency in English is required; German and other languages are an advantage More about us Hitachi Energy is a global technology leader advancing a sustainable energy future for all. You will work in a collaborative and international environment where innovation, learning, and continuous improvement are part of everyday work.

descriptionByLocale.it:
L'opportunità
• Stiamo cercando un ingegnere di progettazione secondaria per unirsi al nostro team di ingegneria GIS. In questo ruolo, supporterete l'esecuzione dei materiali secondari di ingegneria per progetti GIS ad alta tensione, tra cui Local Control Cabinet (LCC) e applicazioni di sottostazione digitale. Contribuirai alla documentazione ingegneristica in tutte le fasi del progetto e contribuirai a fornire risultati di alta qualità, conformi alla norma, mentre costruirai le tue competenze in ingegneria e strumenti di progettazione secondaria come Zuken E3. Come fare un impatto Preparare gli schemi e i relativi documenti di ingegneria per gli ambiti di ingegneria secondaria GIS, comprese le applicazioni di sottostazione LCC e digitale Supportare l'esecuzione di ingegneria attraverso le fasi di progetto, dalla progettazione di base e la progettazione dei dettagli attraverso la documentazione di fabbricazione e gli aggiornamenti costruiti Creare BOM preliminari, rapporti e documenti di fabbricazione utilizzando strumenti di ingegneria approvati e processi standard Lavorerai in un ambiente collaborativo e internazionale dove innovazione, apprendimento e miglioramento continuo fanno parte del lavoro quotidiano.

jobs.title: Junior Process Engineer 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity As a global leader in power semiconductor technology, we offer one of the most diverse product portfolios in the industry. Our products include thyristors, diodes, gate turn-off thyristors, integrated gate-commutated thyristors, insulated-gate bipolar transistors, and metal–oxide–semiconductor field-effect transistors. These components are trusted across sectors such as power transmission and distribution, mobility, and renewable energy for their exceptional quality and reliability. In the role of Process Engineer for BiMOS Backend, you will contribute to the advancement of our automated power module production. You'll have the opportunity to improve existing manufacturing processes and lead innovative development projects, with a particular focus on automated module assembly processes. descriptionByLocale.it: Al nostro Competence Center “Power Converter Solutions”, siamo all’avanguardia nello sviluppo, nella produzione, nell’installazione e nella messa in servizio di convertitori elettronici ad alta potenza per applicazioni come STATCOM, sistemi di alimentazione ferroviaria, sistemi di stoccaggio idropompati e interconnessioni a rete. Le nostre soluzioni svolgono un ruolo chiave nel consentire l'integrazione delle energie rinnovabili nelle moderne reti elettriche, migliorando al contempo l'efficienza complessiva del sistema. Per rafforzare il nostro team di Control Engineering, stiamo cercando un esperto, motivato e hands-on Senior Project Control Engineer con un forte interesse per l'elettronica di potenza e sistemi di controllo. Se sei un apprendimento veloce con una mentalità strutturata e proattiva, e ti piace combinare lavoro di ingegneria con applicazioni reali - questa è la tua opportunità. Come farete un piano d'impatto ed eseguire gli aspetti di ingegneria di controllo dei progetti, compresi i concetti hardware e software, le specifiche e la documentazione Coordinate le interfacce tecniche tra i clienti, i sottofornitori e i team interni Definire e valutare le interfacce hardware, compresi i componenti elettrici e le revisioni di progettazione Guida progettazione concettuale, sviluppo e supporto nell'attuazione del software di controllo e test sulle piattaforme di simulazione in tempo reale Simulink è essenziale, con la programmazione di testi struttati e Hidraw come vantaggio aggiunto Forte conoscenza del controllo dell'elettronica di processo e di potenza e del software di progettazione (ad esempio OLC, CLC, Protezione, HMI) Familiarità con i protocolli di comunicazione industriale (ad esempio OPC, IEC 61850, IEC 60870-5-104, DNP3) è un'esperienza iniziale di test, messa in servizio o ingegneria applicata 20% è un vantaggio di viaggio globale. Le nostre pratiche di lavoro flessibili ti aiutano a ottimizzare le prestazioni personali e aziendali creando un ambiente in cui tutti i dipendenti possono sviluppare le loro competenze e crescere. Inoltre, ci si può aspettare: Lavorare sulle tecnologie all'avanguardia nell'esperienza Power Electronics Hands-on in progetti internazionali e applicazioni nel mondo reale Una combinazione di simulazione, ingegneria e lavoro di progetto in loco Opportunità di crescere in un esperto tecnico all'interno di un business in rapida sviluppo Collaborazione all'interno di un team di ingegneria altamente qualificato e internazionale
descriptionByLocale.en: The opportunity At our Competence Center “Power Converter Solutions”, we are at the forefront of developing, manufacturing, installing, and commissioning high-power electronic converters for applications such as STATCOM, rail power supply systems, hydro pumped storage systems and grid interconnections. Our solutions play a key role in enabling the integration of renewable energy into modern power grids while improving overall system efficiency. To strengthen our Control Engineering team, we are looking for an experienced, motivated and hands-on Senior Project Control Engineer with a strong interest in power electronics and control systems. If you are a fast learner with a structured and proactive mindset, and you enjoy combining engineering work with real-world applications — this is your opportunity. How you'll make an impact Plan and execute control engineering aspects of projects, including hardware and software concepts, specifications, and documentation Coordinate technical interfaces between customers, sub-suppliers, and internal teams Define and evaluate hardware interfaces, including electrical components and design reviews Drive conceptual design, development and support in implementation of control software and testing on real-time simulation platforms Perform commissioning, testing, and customer training on-site Provide technical support during project execution and after delivery Support the sales team in the preparation of technical concepts and tender documentation Collaborate closely with control, system, and mechanical engineering teams as well as project management Your background Degree in Electrical Engineering (Bachelor's or Master's, from a university or university of applied sciences) Min. 5 years of relevant working experience Hands-on experience with MATLAB \/ Simulink is essential, with structed text programming and Hidraw as added advantage Strong knowledge of process and power electronics control and software design (e.g. OLC, CLC, Protection, HMI) Familiarity with industrial communication protocols (e.g. OPC, IEC 61850, IEC 60870-5-104, DNP3) is a plus Initial experience in testing, commissioning, or applied engineering is an advantage Willingness to travel globally for commissioning assignments (approx. 20% of working time) Fluency in English and German More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow. Additionally, you can expect: Work on cutting-edge technologies in Power Electronics Hands-on experience in international projects and real-world applications A combination of simulation, engineering, and on-site project work Opportunity to grow into a technical expert within a rapidly developing business Collaboration within a highly skilled, international engineering team
descriptionByLocale.de: Die Chance In unserem Competence Center „Power Converter Solutions sind wir an der Spitze der Entwicklung, Herstellung, Installation und Inbetriebnahme von elektronischen Hochleistungswandlern für Anwendungen wie STATCOM, Schienenstromversorgungssysteme, hydrogepumpte Speichersysteme und Netzanbindungen. Unsere Lösungen spielen eine Schlüsselrolle bei der Integration erneuerbarer Energien in moderne Stromnetze bei gleichzeitiger Verbesserung der Gesamtsystemeffizienz. Um unser Control Engineering Team zu stärken, suchen wir einen erfahrenen, motivierten und praxisnahen Senior Project Control Engineer mit starkem Interesse an Leistungselektronik und Steuerungssystemen. Wenn Sie ein schneller Lernender mit einer strukturierten und proaktiven Denkweise sind und es genießen, Ingenieurarbeit mit realen Anwendungen zu kombinieren, ist dies Ihre Chance. Wie Sie einen Impact Planen und Ausführen von steuerungstechnischen Aspekten von Projekten, einschließlich Hard- und Softwarekonzepten, Spezifikationen und Dokumentation Koordinieren Sie technische Schnittstellen zwischen Kunden, Unterlieferanten und internen Teams Definieren und bewerten Sie Hardware-Schnittstellen, einschließlich elektrischer Komponenten und Design-Reviews Fahren Sie konzeptionelles Design, Entwicklung und Unterstützung bei der Implementierung von Steuerungssoftware und Tests auf Echtzeit-Simulationsplattformen Durchführung von Inbetriebnahme, Test und Kundenschulung vor Ort Unterstützen Sie das Verkaufsteam bei der Vorbereitung von technischen Konzepten und Ausschreibungsdokumentation Arbeiten Sie eng mit Steuerungs-, System- und Maschinenbauteams zusammen sowie Projektmanagement Ihr Hintergrundstudium in Elektrotechnik (Bachelor oder Master, von einer Universität oder Fachhochschule) Min. 5 Jahre relevante Arbeitserfahrung Simulink ist unerlässlich, mit strukturierter Textprogrammierung und Hidraw als zusätzlichen Vorteil Starke Kenntnisse der Prozess- und Leistungselektroniksteuerung und des Softwaredesigns (z. B. OLC, CLC, Protection, HMI) Vertrautheit mit industriellen Kommunikationsprotokollen (z. B. OPC, IEC 61850, IEC 60870-5-104, DNP3) ist ein Plus Erste Erfahrung in Testen, Inbetriebnahme oder angewandtes Engineering ist ein Vorteil Bereitschaft, weltweit für Inbetriebnahmeaufträge zu reisen (ca. 20% der Arbeitszeit) Unsere flexiblen Arbeitsmethoden helfen Ihnen, die persönliche und geschäftliche Leistung zu optimieren und gleichzeitig ein Umfeld zu schaffen, in dem alle Mitarbeiter ihre Fähigkeiten entwickeln und wachsen können. Darüber hinaus können Sie erwarten: Arbeiten an innovativen Technologien in Power Electronics Praktische Erfahrung in internationalen Projekten und realen Anwendungen Eine Kombination aus Simulation, Engineering und Projektarbeit vor Ort Gelegenheit, in einem sich schnell entwickelnden Business zum technischen Experten zu werden Zusammenarbeit in einem hochqualifizierten, internationalen Engineering-Team
descriptionByLocale.fr: L'opportunité Au sein de notre Centre de Compétences, nous sommes à l'avant-garde du développement, de la fabrication, de l'installation et de la mise en service de convertisseurs électroniques haute puissance pour des applications telles que STATCOM, les systèmes d'alimentation électrique ferroviaire, les systèmes de stockage hydropompés et les interconnexions de réseau. Nos solutions jouent un rôle clé dans l'intégration des énergies renouvelables dans les réseaux électriques modernes tout en améliorant l'efficacité globale du système. Pour renforcer notre équipe d'ingénierie de contrôle, nous sommes à la recherche d'un ingénieur principal de contrôle de projet expérimenté, motivé et pratique avec un grand intérêt pour l'électronique de puissance et les systèmes de contrôle. Si vous êtes un apprenant rapide avec un état d'esprit structuré et proactif, et vous aimez combiner le travail d'ingénierie avec des applications du monde réel — c'est votre opportunité. Comment faire un impact Planifier et exécuter les aspects techniques de contrôle des projets, y compris les concepts matériels et logiciels, les spécifications et la documentation Coordonner les interfaces techniques entre les clients, les sous-fournisseurs et les équipes internes Définir et évaluer les interfaces matérielles, y compris les composants électriques et les examens de conception Conduire la conception conceptuelle, le développement et le soutien dans la mise en œuvre des logiciels de contrôle et les essais sur les plates-formes de simulation en temps réel Effectuer la mise en service, les essais et la formation des clients sur place Fournir un soutien technique pendant l'exécution du projet et après la livraison Soutenir l'équipe de vente dans la préparation des concepts techniques et la documentation d'appel d'offres Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes de contrôle, de système et d'ingénierie mécanique ainsi qu'avec la gestion de projet Vos antécédents en génie électrique (Bachelor's ou Master's, d'une université ou d'une université des sciences appliquées) Simulink est essentiel, avec une programmation textuelle structurée et Hidraw comme avantage supplémentaire Une bonne connaissance du contrôle électronique des processus et de la puissance et de la conception de logiciels (p. ex. CLO, CLC, Protection, HMI) La connaissance des protocoles de communication industrielle (p. ex. COI, CIE 61850, CIE 60870-5-104, DNP3) est une expérience plus initiale dans le test, la mise en service ou l'ingénierie appliquée est un avantage La volonté de voyager à l'échelle mondiale pour des missions de mise en service (environ 20 % du temps de travail) La fluidité en anglais et en allemand Plus sur nous Nos pratiques de travail flexibles vous aident à optimiser la performance personnelle et commerciale tout en créant un environnement où tous les employés peuvent développer leurs compétences et grandir. De plus, vous pouvez vous attendre : Travail sur les technologies de pointe dans l'électronique de puissance Expérience pratique dans les projets internationaux et les applications réelles Une combinaison de travaux de simulation, d'ingénierie et de projet sur place Possibilité de devenir un expert technique au sein d'une entreprise en développement rapide Collaboration au sein d'une équipe d'ingénierie internationale hautement qualifiée

jobs.description: The opportunity Hitachi Energy is a global technology leader that is advancing a sustainable energy future for all. We employ more than 40,000 people in 90 countries who each day work with purpose and use their different backgrounds to challenge the status quo. We welcome you to apply today and be part of a global team that appreciates a simple truth: Diversity + Collaboration = Great Innovation. We operate production facilities in Zurich Oerlikon and ship switchgears all over the world. Therefore, we are looking for an Intern for 12 months as a Junior Project Manager, who helps to bring these large projects to success as well as support our team to improve our day-to-day processes. Join our team! How you'll make an impact Taking over commercial and technical responsibility of one or more GIS customer project(s) (coached by an experienced project manager) Plan project in terms of costs and time schedule Drive engineering phase and make sure that technical issues are resolved quickly prepare and lead meetings with customer Participation in various cost-out projects in collaboration with other departments Improvement of process documentation (workflows, process visualization, continuous improvement process according to lean six sigma principles) Improvement of project management Tools Your background Technical background (BSc or MSc in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering) Knowledge of business administration and excellent communication skills Experienced and interested in working with people at the interface of technology and commercial topics Very good English skills, spoken and written High commitment and ability to adapt to new situations Self-driven personality who is willing to take responsibility More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

jobs.title: Global Product Specialist Transformer Bushings
jobs.description: The opportunity Hitachi Energy is looking for a [Global\/Regional] Product Specialist to join our innovative team in [location]. In this role, you will play a key part in managing the transformers product portfolio, conducting market analysis, and supporting the development of cutting-edge products. This position not only provides a chance to expand your skills and knowledge in the energy industry but also offers the opportunity to contribute to transformative solutions that promote sustainability and advance your career in a rapidly evolving market. How you will make an impact Conduct thorough market analysis to identify trends and assess their impact on the Transformer portfolio. Provide a fresh perspective on differentiating a mature technology and product in the market by analyzing market trends, understanding customer needs, and monitoring competitors' actions with an innovative and creative approach. Evaluate technical requirements and perform competitive assessments to pinpoint product gaps and improvement opportunities. Manage and update technical specifications for existing products to ensure market competitiveness and value. Oversee performance improvement initiatives through benchmarking and quality feedback on assigned products. Ensure compliance with international regulations and industry standards throughout the product lifecycle. Support new product development by translating market requirements into actionable inputs for the product roadmap. Prepare and present technical communication materials to support product launches and enhance market positioning. Develop and deliver engaging training sessions to empower cross-functional teams with the latest product knowledge and market insights. Responsible to ensure compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures, and guidelines. Living Hitachi Energy's core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business. Your background Degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Marketing, or a related field. Minimum of 5 years of experience in product management, market analysis, or a similar role within the transformers or energy industry. Strong technical understanding of energy solutions and industry technologies to effectively communicate product benefits and differentiate offerings. Proven ability to conduct market analysis and competitive assessments to drive product development. Excellent communication and presentation skills for both technical and non-technical audiences. Ability to work collaboratively across cross-functional teams and manage multiple projects simultaneously

descriptionByLocale.en:
The opportunity Join Hitachi Energy's High Voltage Products business and become part of a globally recognized team delivering advanced solutions for power transmission and distribution. In this role, you will support the development and execution of customer-specific projects for Generator Circuit-Breakers used in power generation applications worldwide. With your wiring skills you assist the production and development of Generator Circuit Breakers. How you'll make an impact Create customer-specific wiring and electrical schematics based on technical requirements and project specifications Develop and maintain wiring diagrams for new products and product enhancements using EPLAN P8 Revise electrical documentation to reflect customer requirements, control system changes, and product developments Provide technical support to suppliers involved in control cabinet manufacturing and assembly Maintain and further develop component and language databases within EPLAN P8 Collaborate closely with project managers, engineering teams, suppliers, and international customers Ensure compliance with internal procedures, industry standards, safety regulations, and quality requirements Your background Completed apprenticeship as an Automation Technician or in a similar electrical profession 2 years of professional experience in similar position is an advantage Experience with EPLAN P8 or similar ECAD software is an advantage Strong English language skills; German language skills are an advantage Strong attention to detail and a structured, precise way of working Independent, proactive, and solution-oriented mindset Team player with strong communication and collaboration skills More about us Hitachi Energy's High Voltage Products business is a global leader in power transmission and distribution technologies. Within this business, our Generator Circuit-Breaker team develops, manufactures, markets, and services high-current switching systems for power plants around the world. 
• We offer an inclusive and collaborative work environment, flexible working models, and exciting opportunities for professional growth. Join us and help shape a more sustainable energy future for generations to come.

jobs.title: Internship in Semiconductor Packaging 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity The Research Team Semiconductor Packaging and Reliability Engineering at our Swiss Power Grids Research Center is looking for an intern student with expertise in electrical engineering, physics, materials and analytical methods to contribute to the development of novel semiconductor power modules for e-mobility and grid applications. The intern will interact with a dynamic and multidisciplinary team that will supervise and guide the project. If you have a strong technical background, motivation to develop innovative solutions, and you are goal-oriented, this is your opportunity to contribute in building a stronger and more sustainable energy future. The duration of the internship is six months. 
• Your responsibilities Support technology development and research activities in the development of semiconductor power modules, i.e. process development and prototype manufacturing in a state-of-the-art cleanroom Perform accelerated lifetime testing, characterize modules before and after aging, supervise the test setup Perform first steps of the root cause analysis (X-ray, SAM, cross section etc.) and concisely document the test results Perform electromagnetic and thermal infinite element simulations to validate design features Create CAD designs of power modules in close collaboration with the team, find creative and efficient solutions to meet demanding and sometimes conflicting requirements Your background Currently pursuing a M.Sc. degree in material science, electrical engineering, physics, chemistry or similar discipline (advanced B.Sc. or M.Sc. degree); official enrollment essential Experience in laboratory work and know-how in experimental methods using a wide range of advanced materials characterization techniques Solid programming skills (e.g. LabVIEW, Python, Matlab etc.) Experience with finite element modeling advantageous (ANSYS Q3D, COMSOL) Know-how in data analysis tools and statistics is advantageous Enthusiastic, self-motivated mindset and ability to work independently as well as highly conscientious individual with keen sense of responsibility Fluency in written and spoken English and good communication and technical writing skills Motivated and eager to learn more and become part of a multidisciplinary research team focused on innovation More about us We are a technology-driven company with a strong focus on innovation, continuous improvement, and sustainable manufacturing. 
• We offer flexible working conditions, dedicated mentorship, and a supportive, inclusive environment where you can grow personally and professionally – empowering you to thrive while balancing life and work.

Lo stage interagirà con un team dinamico e multidisciplinare che supervisionerà e guiderà il progetto. Se avete un forte background tecnico, motivazione per sviluppare soluzioni innovative, e siete orientati verso l'obiettivo, questa è la vostra opportunità di contribuire a costruire un futuro energetico più forte e sostenibile. Esperienza con elementi finiti di modellazione vantaggiosa (ANSYS Q3D, COMSOL) Il know-how negli strumenti e nelle statistiche di analisi dei dati è vantaggioso Enthusiastic, self-motivated mindset e la capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente e altamente coscienzioso individuo con un senso acuto di responsabilità Fluency in inglese scritto e parlato e buone capacità di comunicazione e scrittura tecnica Motivated e desideroso di imparare di più forte e diventare parte di un team di ricerca multidisciplinare focalizzato sull'innovazione
