Polymechaniker, Industriemechaniker, Werkzeugmacher, Schreiner) Mehrjährige Erfahrung in einer ähnlichen Funktion, idealerweise in der Planung oder Fertigung Sehr gute Kenntnisse im Lesen technischer Zeichnungen und Stücklisten Sicherer Umgang mit SAP und Microsoft Office Selbstständige, detailorientierte Arbeitsweise und Teamfähigkeit Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse sowie gute Englischkenntnisse Mehr über uns Unsere flexiblen Arbeitsmodelle helfen Ihnen, die persönliche und geschäftliche Leistung zu optimieren und gleichzeitig ein Umfeld zu schaffen, in dem alle Mitarbeitenden befähigt sind und sich entfalten können.

descriptionByLocale.it:

Come protagonista in settori come l'energia, la ferrovia, l'aerospaziale, i servizi industriali, e altro ancora, siamo orgogliosi di fornire soluzioni personalizzate, affidabili e innovative ai nostri clienti globali. Entra a far parte del nostro team dinamico di Klingnau, specializzato nella lavorazione di materie plastiche ad alta precisione di livello mondiale. Come player chiave in settori come l'energia, la ferrovia, l'aerospaziale, i servizi industriali e altro ancora, siamo orgogliosi di fornire soluzioni su misura, affidabili e innovative ai nostri clienti globali. jobs.description: The opportunity Are you passionate about creating a safe and sustainable working environment where people can thrive? As our HSE Manager for PSC Switzerland, you will take full ownership of the Health, Safety, and Environment function and play a key role in shaping a strong safety culture across our organization. In this position, you will lead and develop the HSE team while acting as the Site Lead Manager (HSE) for our Training Center in Rüti and Service Logistic Center in Dietlikon. You will collaborate closely with leadership, employees, and external partners to ensure the highest health and safety standards, drive continuous improvement, and make a tangible impact on how we protect our people and operations every day. How you'll make an impact Lead HSE function and team for PSC Switzerland and serve as Site Lead Manager (HSE) for Training Center in Rüti and Service Logistic Center in Dietlikon  Ensure strong commitment to health and safety standards, guidelines, management systems, and procedures  Communicate health and safety initiatives, processes, and procedures to ensure uniform understanding across the organization  Monitor compliance with health and safety requirements and handle non-conformances according to established procedures  Assist and guide management, supervisors, and employees in accident prevention and act as an interface with contractors and clients when needed  Implement and maintain the health and safety management system and ensure quality input where necessary  Conduct safety audits, investigate accidents, identify root causes, and supervise corrective actions  Provide guidance on competency-based health and safety training and lead HSE and Sustainability Reviews for Rüti and Dietlikon, ensuring assurance activities are completed  Your background 5+ years of experience in managerial role in industrial company, preferably in HSE, construction or factory environment  Strong leadership personality and excellent interpersonal and communication skills  Understanding of health and safety in project\/customer sites and the role a safety system plays in managing the overall risk profile of a site  Practical “hands-on” experience in developing and managing safety systems with the ability to dig into site-specific details and develop solutions to complex safety issues  Knowledge about OSHA legislation for construction sites and working experience in Safety-related positions  International experience and intercultural sensitivity and Solutions-oriented personality with strong engagement  Proficiency in English (written and oral), German of advantage and any other language is a plus  Approximately 25% Travel required More about us   Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

jobs.title: Shift Equipment Maintenance Engineer – Etching 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity  Join our innovative team as a Shift Maintenance Engineer and play a critical role in the heart of semiconductor production! With a strong focus on etching processes, you'll work with cutting-edge technology to optimize system performance and ensure seamless operations. This is your opportunity to collaborate with experts, contribute to groundbreaking projects, and grow in a dynamic, high-tech environment. If you're passionate about precision and innovation, we want to hear from you!   How you'll make an impact  Maintain and optimize wet chemical and plasma etch equipment to ensure high availability  Troubleshoot and repair complex systems in collaboration with OEM partners  Plan and support preventive maintenance activities to improve tool performance  Manage spare parts and contribute to equipment upgrades and process improvements  Collaborate with engineering, R&D, and operations teams to support production goals  Create and maintain technical documentation and support data tracking in MES systems  Identify and implement improvements in tools, processes, and operational efficiency  Ensure compliance with HSE standards and promote a safe working environment  Your background  Technical vocational training in automation, electronics, or a related field (EFZ or equivalent)  2+ years of experience in equipment maintenance in semiconductor or similar industries  Strong technical knowledge in plasma tools (e.g. AMAT, LAM systems)  Solid understanding of electronics, mechanics, pneumatics, and vacuum systems  Ability to work in a team-oriented environment and within shift operations  Good communication skills in English (German is a plus)  More about us   You will join a dynamic and fast-paced production environment where teamwork, reliability, and technical excellence are key.  Working in a shift-based setup, you will be part of a highly skilled maintenance team supporting critical operations and advanced manufacturing processes.  This role offers hands-on experience with complex technologies and the opportunity to develop your technical skills while contributing directly to production stability and performance.

jobs.title: Umweltspezialist 80 - 100% (w/m/d)
jobs.description: Über die Position Gestalte aktiv die Zukunft mit – dort, wo Sicherheit und Innovation aufeinandertreffen. Wir suchen eine engagierte und fachkompetente Umweltspezialistin bzw. einen engagierten und fachkompetenten Umweltspezialisten, die\/der unser Bestreben nach einem sicheren, gesunden und nachhaltigen Arbeitsumfeld weiter stärkt. Störfallverordnung, Chemikalienrecht, Umweltschutzrecht) Erfahrung in der Durchführung von Risikoanalysen, Gefahrenermittlungen sowie Unfall und Ereignisabklärungen, inklusive Ableitung von Massnahmen Praxis in der Planung, Durchführung und Nachbereitung von Audits, Inspektionen und internen Begehungen, idealerweise gemäss ISO 14001 \/ ISO 45001 Starke Kommunikations- und Beratungskompetenzen für die Unterstützung von Führungskräften, Projektleitenden und Mitarbeitenden in HSE-Belangen Fähigkeit zur Erstellung und Durchführung von Schulungen zu Arbeitssicherheit, Umwelt und Nachhaltigkeit, sowie Analytische Fähigkeiten und Erfahrung im Umgang mit HSE-Kennzahlen, Reporting und kontinuierlicher Verbesserung Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse sowie gute Englischkenntnisse, weitere Landessprachen von Vorteil Mehr über uns Unsere flexiblen Arbeitsmodelle helfen Ihnen, persönliche und berufliche Leistung zu optimieren und schaffen ein Umfeld, in dem alle Mitarbeitenden ihre Fähigkeiten weiterentwickeln und wachsen können.

descriptionByLocale.en: Through the position, actively shape the future – where security and innovation meet. jobs.title: Semiconductor Shift Maintenance Engineer – Implant 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity Are you passionate about driving innovation and ensuring maximum uptime of semiconductor production tools? As an Implant Maintenance Engineer\/Technician, you play a vital role in ensuring the availability, reliability, and continuous improvement of our semiconductor production tool park. Your focus is on the corrective, preventive and predictive maintenance of implant equipment, working cross-functionally to drive safety, productivity, and general tool and workflow optimizations across the production line. How you'll make an impact Ensure maximum uptime of semiconductor production tools through proactive maintenance and troubleshooting of implant equipment Drive continuous improvement in equipment performance, applying workplace safety and efficiency practices aligned with 6S methodology Collaborate closely with other maintenance, process, and production teams to achieve performance goals and optimize line efficiency Participate in tool upgrades and modernization projects to enhance tool capability and reliability Maintain accurate and detailed documentation of maintenance activities, equipment status, and system performance Support root-cause analysis and problem resolution for technical issues within the team Train and mentor colleagues in the areas of implant, safety, and best maintenance practices Promote a strong safety culture by ensuring compliance with all relevant regulations, procedures and documentations Your background Hands-on experience in maintenance of semiconductor production tools Solid understanding of electronics, mechanics and pneumatics Minimum 3 years of experience with ion implanters (such as AMAT or Nissin or Axcelis) Familiarity with metrology tools for process control (Semilab WT-2000) Additional training or expertise in vacuum systems or related technologies Completed technical vocational training (e.g., Automation Technician, Electronics Technician, or similar field) Willingness to work in shifts is a must Strong team player with problem-solving mentality, organizational skills, and proficiency in English (German is a plus) More about us Hitachi Energy offers you interesting tasks in a highly motivated team and an open communication style. Through an individual and practice-oriented induction plan, we will support you to quickly gain professional confidence to be able to work independently with high level of personal responsibility.

jobs.title: Laboratory Manager – High Voltage Testing 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity Our local product group Insulation & Components is the technology leader in design and manufacture of high volt-age transformer bushings. All renowned international companies of the electrical industry, active in power genera-tion, transmission and distribution are among our customers. We have a top position in the high voltage trans-former bushing areas worldwide. In this highly responsible and dynamic role, you will lead our laboratory team at MICAFIL in Zürich-Altstetten (ZH) and ensure that we further strengthen our competitiveness and develop our Swiss branch to meet the global market growth in the field of energy. In this important role, you will continuously drive forward the efficient and innovative processes of our 3 different laboratories together with a strong team. If you have a passion for leadership and high voltage testing, we offer you the stage to bring about real change and actively shape the future of our production processes. How you'll make an impact Lead the laboratory team, including resource management and team development (15 FTE) and act as the point of contact for HV testing at Zürich-Altstetten MICAFIL Ensure compliance with safety and quality standards (IEC\/IEEE) Analyze & implement efficient production & business processes to increase safety, quality and productivity  Ensure high output through reliable high-voltage testing procedures (AC, DC, impulse, partial discharge) Identify and integrate new technologies and best practices to drive the continuous improvement process (CIP) together with your team and our Process Engineering team Collaborate closely with planning, quality assurance, logistics, other production departments and relevant stakeholders for holistic process design and improvement  Be responsible for optimal work and maintenance instructions and other relevant regulations (e.g. ISO, Lean, Six Sigma) Develop and monitor the most important key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure success and re-port to operations manager As People Manager, you will be responsible to ensure compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures and guidelines Your background Technical apprenticeship and qualifications (Bachelor \/ Master) in the field of Electrical Engineering or equivalent Several years of experience in a similar leadership position (High-Voltage Testing\/Insulation Technology\/Power Engineering) Solid knowledge in high-voltage systems, generators, and automation systems Solid knowledge of lean management, Six Sigma and other process optimization methods Proven experience in leading and motivating cross-functional teams Strong problem-solving skills and a data-driven approach to decision making combined with a strong focus on safety Excellent time management, communication and organizational skills Fluent in German and English More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptionByLocale.de: Die Chance Unsere lokale Produktgruppe Insulation & Components ist der Technologieführer in der Entwicklung und Herstellung von Hochvoltdurchführungen für Transformatoren. Alle namhaften internationalen Unternehmen der Elektroindustrie, die in der Energieerzeugung, -übertragung und -verteilung tätig sind, gehören zu unseren Kunden. In dieser sehr verantwortungsvollen und dynamischen Rolle werden Sie unser Laborteam bei MICAFIL in Zürich-Altstetten (ZH) leiten und dafür sorgen, dass wir unsere Wettbewerbsfähigkeit weiter stärken und unsere Schweizer Niederlassung weiter ausbauen, um dem globalen Marktwachstum im Energiebereich gerecht zu werden. In dieser wichtigen Rolle treiben Sie die effizienten und innovativen Prozesse unserer 3 verschiedenen Labore mit einem starken Team kontinuierlich voran. Wenn Sie eine Leidenschaft für Führung und Hochspannungstests haben, bieten wir Ihnen die Bühne, um echte Veränderungen herbeizuführen und die Zukunft unserer Produktionsprozesse aktiv zu gestalten. Führen Sie das Laborteam, einschließlich Ressourcenmanagement und Teamentwicklung (15 FTE) und fungieren Sie als Ansprechpartner für HV-Tests in Zürich-Altstetten MICAFIL Gewährleistung der Einhaltung von Sicherheits- und Qualitätsstandards (IEC\/IEEE) Analysieren und implementieren Sie effiziente Produktions- und Geschäftsprozesse, um Sicherheit, Qualität und Produktivität zu erhöhen Sicherstellen einer hohen Leistung durch zuverlässige Hochspannungstestverfahren (AC, DC, Impuls, Teilentladung) Identifizieren und integrieren Sie neue Technologien und Best Practices, um den kontinuierlichen Verbesserungsprozess (CIP) gemeinsam mit Ihrem Team und unserem Process Engineering-Team voranzutreiben Arbeiten Sie eng mit Planung, Qualitätssicherung, Logistik, anderen Produktionsabteilungen und relevanten Stakeholdern für ganzheitliche Prozessgestaltung und -verbesserung Seien Sie verantwortlich für optimale Arbeits- und Wartungsanweisungen und andere relevante Vorschriften (z. B. descriptionByLocale.fr: L'opportunité Notre groupe de produits local Isolation & Components est le leader technologique dans la conception et la fabrication de douilles de transformateurs à haute tension. Toutes les entreprises internationales de renom de l'industrie électrique, actives dans la génération de puissance, la transmission et la distribution sont parmi nos clients. Nous avons une position supérieure dans les zones de douille de transformateur haute tension dans le monde entier. Dans ce rôle très responsable et dynamique, vous dirigerez notre équipe de laboratoire à la MICAFIL à Zürich-Altstetten (ZH) et vous assurerez que nous renforçons notre compétitivité et développons notre succursale suisse pour répondre à la croissance du marché mondial de l'énergie. Dans ce rôle important, vous allez continuer à faire avancer les processus efficaces et innovants de nos 3 laboratoires différents avec une équipe forte. Si vous avez une passion pour le leadership et les tests haute tension, nous vous offrons la scène pour apporter un réel changement et façonner activement l'avenir de nos processus de production. Comment faire un impact Diriger l'équipe de laboratoire, y compris la gestion des ressources et le développement de l'équipe (15 ETP) et agir comme point de contact pour les tests HV à Zürich-Altstetten MICAFIL Assurer le respect des normes de sécurité et de qualité (IEC\/IEEE) Analyser et mettre en oeuvre des processus de production et d'affaires efficaces pour accroître la sécurité, la qualité et la productivité Assurer un rendement élevé grâce à des procédures d'essai fiables à haute tension (AC, DC, impulsion, décharge partielle) Identifier et intégrer les nouvelles technologies et les meilleures pratiques pour piloter le processus d'amélioration continue (CIP) en collaboration avec votre équipe et notre équipe d'ingénierie des processus Collaborer étroitement avec la planification, l'assurance de la qualité, la logistique, d'autres services de production et les intervenants pertinents pour la conception et l'amélioration holistiques des processus Soyez responsable des instructions de travail et de maintenance optimales et d'autres règlements pertinents (p. ex. ISO, Lean, Six Sigma) Élaborer et surveiller les indicateurs de rendement clés les plus importants (ICP) pour mesurer le succès et le transfert au gestionnaire des opérations En tant que gestionnaire des personnes, vous serez responsable d'assurer le respect des règlements, procédures et lignes directrices externes et internes applicables Votre formation Apprentissage technique et qualifications (Bachelor \/ Master) dans le domaine du génie électrique ou équivalent Plusieurs années d'expérience dans un poste de leadership similaire (essais à haute tension\/technologie d'isolation\/ingénierie de puissance) Savoir-faire solide dans les systèmes à haute tension, les générateurs et les systèmes d'automatisation Savoir-faire solide en gestion maigre, Six Sigma et autres méthodes d'optimisation des processus Expérience éprouvée dans la conduite et la motivation d'équipes interfonctionnelles Des compétences solides en résolution de problèmes et une approche de la prise de décision axée sur les données combinée à une forte concentration sur la sécurité Excellente gestion du temps, communication et compétences organisationnelles Fluent en allemand et en anglais Plus sur nous Nos pratiques de travail flexibles vous aident à optimiser la performance personnelle et professionnelle tout en créant un environnement où tous les employés peuvent développer leurs compétences et grandir.

jobs.title: Industrial Engineer for GIS Production 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity We are seeking a highly motivated Industrial Engineer with a focus on Automation and Robotics to optimize and improve the efficiency of our Gas Insulated Switchgear (GIS) production lines. This role involves applying industrial engineering principles as well as automation technologies and robotic solutions to enhance manufacturing processes, reduce waste, and improve productivity. Motivated graduates with a strong focus on automation and robotics are also encouraged to apply. How you'll make an impact Analyse current GIS production line layouts, workflows, and operational procedures to identify areas for improvement in efficiency, cost, and quality, with a focus on automation potential Design and implement optimized production processes, including new methodologies, automation concepts, robotic applications, equipment utilization, and material flow Conduct time and motion studies, process mapping, and value stream analysis to identify bottlenecks and eliminate non-value-added activities. Develop and implement standard operating procedures (SOPs) and work instructions for GIS assembly and testing, including automated and robot-assisted processes Collaborate with other industrial engineers, production managers, design engineers, quality and new product implementation team Lead and participate in continuous improvement initiatives, including Lean Manufacturing and Six Sigma projects, leveraging digitalization and automation technologies Evaluate, specify, and implement new technologies, including robotics (e.g., cobots), automated systems, and smart manufacturing solutions for the GIS production environment Your background Master's degree in Automation Engineering, Robotics, Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related field Initial professional experience in industrial engineering within a manufacturing environment is preferred Initial or proven experience with industrial automation and\/or robotics integration (e.g., robotic cells, cobots, automated material handling systems) Strong background in process optimization, lean manufacturing principles, and continuous improvement methodologies (e.g., Kaizen, Six Sigma) Proficiency in process analysis tools (e.g., value stream mapping, time studies, statistical process control) Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with diverse teams and manage multiple projects simultaneously Familiarity with GIS production processes or similar complex electrical equipment manufacturing is highly desirable Business fluent in English and German More about us   Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

How you'll make an impact Analyse current GIS production line layouts, workflows, and operational procedures to identify areas for improvement in efficiency, cost, and quality, with a focus on automation potential Design and implement optimized production processes, including new methodologies, automation concepts, robotic applications, equipment utilization, and material flow Conduct time and motion studies, process mapping, and value stream analysis to identify bottlenecks and eliminate non-value-added activities. Develop and implement standard operating procedures (SOPs) and work instructions for GIS assembly and testing, including automated and robot-assisted processes Collaborate with other industrial engineers, production managers, design engineers, quality and new product implementation team Lead and participate in continuous improvement initiatives, including Lean Manufacturing and Six Sigma projects, leveraging digitalization and automation technologies Evaluate, specify, and implement new technologies, including robotics (e.g., cobots), automated systems, and smart manufacturing solutions for the GIS production environment Your background Master's degree in Automation Engineering, Robotics, Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related field Initial professional experience in industrial engineering within a manufacturing environment is preferred Initial or proven experience with industrial automation and\/or robotics integration (e.g., robotic cells, cobots, automated material handling systems) Strong background in process optimization, lean manufacturing principles, and continuous improvement methodologies (e.g., Kaizen, Six Sigma) Proficiency in process analysis tools (e.g., value stream mapping, time studies, statistical process control) Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with diverse teams and manage multiple projects simultaneously Familiarity with GIS production processes or similar complex electrical equipment manufacturing is highly desirable Business fluent in English and German More about us   Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

jobs.title: Operational Procurement Team Leader - 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity Lead and manage a team of procurement professionals to ensure efficient and effective operational procurement activities, supporting HITACHI ENERGY business objectives and supply chain optimization. How you'll make an impact Manage and mentor a team of procurement specialists, fostering a collaborative and high-performing environment. Oversee the end-to-end operational procurement process, including requisitioning, purchase order creation, expediting, and invoice resolution. Develop and implement procurement strategies to optimize delivery performance for assigned categories. Monitor key procurement metrics, analyze performance data, and identify areas for improvement. Collaborate closely with internal stakeholders (e.g., engineering, manufacturing, logistics, finance, planning ) to understand their needs and ensure timely and effective supply. Ensure compliance with all company policies and procedures. Drive continuous improvement initiatives within the procurement function, leveraging best practices and technology. Resolve complex supplier issues effectively and efficiently. Your background Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related field. Minimum of 5-7 years of experience in procurement, ideally with 2 years in a leadership or supervisory role. Proven experience in operational procurement within a manufacturing or industrial environment. Strong understanding of procurement best practices and supplier relationship management. Proficiency in SAP Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills. Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities. Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment. Certifications such as CIPS (Chartered Institute of Procurement & Supply) or equivalent are a plus. English on negotiation level, German should be B1 More about us You will do interesting and enriching work as part of a dynamic, passionate, and collaborative team committed to innovation and continuous improvement You will be stretched, encouraged, and supported to grow – we pride ourselves on providing strong learning and development opportunities 
• We offer an environment that fosters collaboration, connection, and diversity of thought Our culture is one of a kind: come as you are and bring your unique attributes, passion, and drive to the design and management of Pensions & Benefits at Hitachi Energy, contributing to making us ‘the place to be' and to our purpose of advancing a sustainable energy future for all Flexible working, including hybrid\/remote working opportunities A competitive compensation and benefits package

jobs.title: Global Manufacturing Process Definition & Improvement Specialist Professional
jobs.description: The Opportunity At Hitachi Energy, our purpose is advancing a sustainable energy future for all. We bring power to our homes, schools, hospitals, and factories. Join us and work with fantastic people, while learning and developing yourself on projects that have a real impact to our communities and society. Bring your passion, bring your energy, and be part of a global team that appreciates a simple truth: Diversity + Collaboration = Great Innovation. The Global Transfer of Technology Process Professional is responsible for driving the standardization, optimization, and continuous improvement of manufacturing processes across HITACHI ENERGY Distribution Transformers global operations. This role involves defining best practices, developing new process technologies, and implementing robust solutions to enhance efficiency, quality, and cost-effectiveness. How you'll make an impact: Define, document, and standardize manufacturing processes globally, ensuring consistency and adherence to best practices as well as making sure these are globally transferred to support capacity expansion projects. Lead and support process improvement initiatives, utilizing methodologies such as Lean, Six Sigma, and Industry 4.0 principles to optimize manufacturing operations. Identify opportunities for process automation, digital transformation, and the integration of advanced manufacturing technologies. Collaborate with R&D, engineering, production, quality teams and especially with our Global Platform Leaders to ensure seamless new product introductions and process validations&Develop and deliver training programs to manufacturing personnel on new processes, technologies, and improvement methodologies. Conduct process audits and performance analyses to identify bottlenecks, inefficiencies, and areas for improvement. Benchmark internal and external manufacturing processes to identify industry best practices and innovative solutions. Manage complex process improvement & capacity expansion projects, including scope definition, resource allocation, timeline management, and stakeholder communication. Ensure compliance with relevant industry standards, regulations, and internal quality management systems&Provide expert technical support and guidance to manufacturing sites worldwide on process-related issues. Responsible to ensure compliance with applicable external & internal regulations, procedures & guidelines. Your Background Bachelor's degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial, Manufacturing, or related field). Master's degree preferred. Strong experience in manufacturing engineering, process development, or continuous improvement roles within a global manufacturing environment. Proven track record of successfully leading and implementing significant manufacturing process improvements and transfer of technology projects. Strong knowledge of Lean manufacturing principles, Six Sigma methodologies (Green Belt or Black Belt certification highly desirable) & Experience with advanced manufacturing technologies, automation, and digital manufacturing solutions (e.g., MES, SCADA, AI\/ML in manufacturing). Proficiency in process simulation software, CAD\/CAM tools, and statistical analysis software. Excellent project management, analytical, problem-solving, decision-making, communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to manage multiple complex projects simultaneously and effectively influence stakeholders at all organizational levels. Ability to travel internationally as required (up to 30-50%). Fluency in English is required; proficiency in other languages is a plus. More about us We pride ourselves on offering a holistic range of competitive benefits to support your financial, physical, and mental wellbeing, as well as your professional growth. We want you to truly thrive with us, in work and out.
